about: Central transaction-charge configuration. Every rate is a percentage of the stated base unless the field says otherwise, and every rate is a dated schedule: the entry with the latest `from` on or before the trade date applies. Nothing else in the application holds a charge rate. frontend/lib/regulatory/charges.json is a byte-for-byte mirror; a test fails if they drift.
disclaimer: Charges are simulated and may differ from your actual broker.

sources.title: Union Budget 2026-27: STT on futures raised to 0.05% and on options to 0.15% from 1 Apr 2026; equity delivery and intraday unchanged
NSE circular 27 Feb 2026: transaction charges revised from 1 Mar 2026 as the IPFT contribution was rolled back, overall outflow unchanged
Published broker schedule of exchange, SEBI, stamp-duty and GST charges
SEBI circular 8 Aug 2025: transaction charges payable to mutual fund distributors discontinued

rounding.note: Components are rounded to the paisa; STT is rounded to the nearest rupee, as on a contract note. The total is the sum of the rounded components.

gst.note: GST applies to brokerage, exchange transaction charges (including IPFT), SEBI turnover fees and depository charges. It is not charged on STT or stamp duty, and never on the trade value.

sebi.note: Rs 10 per crore of turnover, on both sides, in every segment.

exchangeCharges.note: All-in exchange transaction charge, as a percentage of turnover (premium for options). NSE entries are the transaction charge plus the Investor Protection Fund Trust (IPFT) contribution; the 1 Mar 2026 revision moved most of the IPFT amount into the transaction charge and left the total unchanged.

equity.note: Common rate for A and B group scrips. BSE varies this by scrip group.

options.note: Sensex and Bankex index options, on premium.

stampDuty.note: Buy side only, as a percentage of the buy value (premium for options). Rates are set by the Indian Stamp Act and differ by transaction type; they are not one rate for every trade.

options.label: Options
options.note: STT is on the option premium, sell side. Exercise-time STT is not simulated.

depository.note: Depository (DP) charge: a per-scrip, per-day fee on delivery sells. It is a broker setting, not a regulation, so it lives in the broker profile.

stampDuty.note: 0.005% of the purchase amount. It is taken out of the money invested, so the units allotted are (amount - duty) / NAV. It is not charged again on redemption. Transfer of units (demat, off-market) is treated differently and is not simulated.

sttOnRedemption.note: STT of 0.001% is deducted by the AMC on redemption of equity-oriented fund units. It is not an allowable deduction when computing the capital gain.

distributorTransactionCharge.note: The Rs 100 / Rs 150 transaction charge once deducted from the first-time and repeat investor's subscription was discontinued by SEBI on 8 Aug 2025. The simulator charges nothing for it.

expenseRatio.note: The expense ratio is charged inside the fund and is already reflected in the NAV. It is not a transaction charge and is never deducted from your returns a second time.

exitLoad.note: Exit load is set by each scheme and changes over time. No free, dependable source publishes it, so the simulator uses a value you enter from the scheme information document and says so when none is entered.

instrumentMap.note: How each simulated instrument is charged. An index quote is not directly tradable in India, so a domestic index position is charged as the nearest tradable form, a future. Instruments with no Indian schedule modelled are listed under `unmodelled` and carry no charges.

default-simulator.label: Default Simulator
default-simulator.description: A traditional broker: a percentage brokerage on delivery, a capped percentage on intraday, flat per order on F&O.

discount-flat.label: Discount broker
discount-flat.description: Free equity delivery; intraday 0.03% or Rs 20 per order, whichever is lower; Rs 20 per order on F&O.

full-service.label: Full-service broker
full-service.description: Higher percentage brokerage with a per-order minimum.

custom.label: Custom
custom.description: Your own brokerage numbers. Statutory charges stay as above.

brokerProfiles.brokerageShape: pct: percentage of turnover. flat: rupees per executed order. cap: ceiling on the calculated amount. min: floor on the calculated amount. If both pct and flat are given, pct wins.
